message: Hi, I'm a student with a distro making certification background. My overall academic average is 77.9% in an IT/computer-science degree. I'm interested in Computer Architecture and testing. I want to become a Database Developer. My family can afford at most about USD 10200 per year. I live in Pune. I'm open to going abroad.

other_constraints: Interested in Computer Architecture and testing

explanation:
This program is an excellent international option focusing on your interest in testing (QA Testing) while remaining within your family's budget with a tuition of $5750. Located in Germany, it offers a substantial post-study work visa of 18 months, which is highly beneficial for career growth abroad. The main trade-off here is that the minimum required grade percentage (62%) is lower than your current average, but this makes the program more accessible internationally.

This option perfectly aligns with your location preference in Pune and your interest in testing (QA Testing). With a low annual tuition of $2400, it is highly budget-friendly. The program requires no CS background knowledge, making it accessible despite the minimum grade requirement being 70%. Since this is an Indian institution, there is no post-study work visa benefit to consider.

This MCA program in Germany provides a strong blend of data science analytics and software engineering, fitting your goal of becoming a Database Developer. The tuition is very low at $2050, making it highly cost-effective for an international move. You must meet the requirement of having a CS background, but this option offers 18 months of post-study work visa time.

This program is ideal for focusing on data analytics while keeping you local in Pune. With a tuition cost of $2350, it respects your budget and directly addresses the data aspect of your career goal. The main trade-off is that this specialized Big Data Analytics course requires a CS background, which aligns well with your certification history.

If you are prioritizing international experience and testing skills, this UK program is a strong contender. At $10050, it utilizes almost your entire budget while offering the maximum post-study work visa of 24 months. The trade-off compared to other options is that its tuition cost is very high, though it still remains within your stated financial limit.
